description: Murkmire reed/stilt building culture — the BM&V passerelles walkway system (curving, climbing, branching), stilt house shells, the vanilla plank/thatch shack kit with its broken variants, waterside work props and poled rafts. Only plank_ferry_swamp_01/03 and rowboat_ferry_swamp_01 carry real hull geometry in the Skyrim Ferries pool; swamp_02/04/05/06 are editor markers and are excluded. Second sourcing pass adds the Skyfall Hist tree, Hist flowers, cairns/rune circle as grave-stake stand-ins, a real dugout canoe and a poled ferry raft. Round 5 adds Here There Be Monsters' Black Marsh village set: two bamboo hut forms with a door, the wicker furniture family, and the Kothringi stilt platform and Tamu wood dock/plank family (with broken variants) — the first purpose-built Black Marsh dwelling forms we own beyond a single shell.
